claims.evidence: No origin stickers, JDM auction sheet, or import documentation visible in either photo; wet concrete ground and watermark give no origin clues.
No grading sheet, auction inspection sticker, or condition report visible; casing shows dirt/wetness but no internal condition evidence.
No manufacturer nameplate, part number, or model code legible in either photo; fitment cannot be confirmed from casing shape alone.

risks.risk: Exact part number / model compatibility (which Rogue/Altima generation, engine, drivetrain) unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of the transmission ID tag/casting number stamped on the case
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unverified-fitment unit, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: Internal condition (clutch packs, gears, torque converter) unknown — only external casing shown
risks.proof: Video of unit being turned on a bench/test rig or dyno/stall test clip
risks.if_unproven: price as untested, worst-case non-functional core

risks.risk: Completeness — sensors, mounts, torque converter, dipstick, wiring harness may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set with all connector points and converter visible, plus parts checklist from seller
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete unit pending full parts list confirmation

risks.risk: Fluid condition / leaks / contamination not visible (ground is wet, could be unrelated spill or an actual leak)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of drain plug, pan gasket, and dipstick fluid color/smell description with video pour

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal (accident, failure, or routine swap) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle odometer or Japan export auction sheet with mileage
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-mileage, higher risk of hidden wear

risks.risk: 'Tokunbo'/Japan-grade claim could be unverifiable marketing; no auction sheet or customs paperwork shown
risks.proof: Photo/scan of Japanese auction sheet, bill of lading, or customs import clearance document
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified-origin, treat as domestic-used grade

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the ID/casting tag with part number and model code
Video of the torque converter spinning freely by hand and visible converter condition
Photo/scan of Japan auction sheet or import documents supporting tokunbo and grade claim
Full set of photos showing all connectors, sensors, and mounting points for completeness check
Close-up of drain plug/pan area and a sample of the transmission fluid
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a disassembled automatic transmission/transaxle assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, untested internal condition, unproven origin/grade) pending the listed proofs.
